notes: ci.yml adds an end-to-end job through check-browser.yml@v1, because the generators only prove themselves against a production build in a real browser.
ci.yml adds a release job through release-changesets.yml@v1 after check and end-to-end, because the app versions and tags releases with Changesets while Cloudflare deploys main.

tsconfig.json turns noUncheckedIndexedAccess off, enables resolveJsonModule for package.json imports, and maps @/* to src/*, because the geometry code indexes arrays heavily and the app imports through @/.

.oxlintrc.json also extends the domain preset so src/core stays free of Node, framework, and app-layer imports, and relaxes a few a11y and React rules for the vendored shadcn components in src/components/ui.
.oxfmtrc.json ignores dist and pnpm-lock.yaml so formatting checks skip build output and the lockfile.
vitest.config.ts runs in the node environment with a 30s timeout, because export-quality geometry builds take several seconds on CI runners.
pnpm check also runs pnpm build, because the build runs the SEO prerender and is the whole deploy risk for this static site.
The app releases with Changesets but has no changeset check in pnpm check, because changeset status demands a changeset on every change and tooling-only changes deliberately have none.
vitest stays on 5.x and pnpm on 12.x, newer majors than the recipe lists, because the app already ran on them.
package.json keeps the Playwright, samples, and Changesets scripts, and .gitignore keeps the app outputs (test-results, makerworld/images, printables/files, .wrangler).
AGENTS.md keeps the app guide and adds the recipe paragraph after its introduction.
